summary: Sohu.com Limited furnished a Form 6-K reporting the results of its 2026 Annual General Meeting held in Beijing on September 16, 2026, the US-equivalent disclosure for a foreign private issuer. Shareholders elected Class I directors Dr. Charles Zhang, Dr. Zhonghan Deng and Mr. Dave De Yang by plurality, with withheld votes of roughly 7.4-7.6 million each, and ratified PricewaterhouseCoopers Zhong Tian LLP as independent auditors for fiscal 2026 by 18,279,046 votes for versus 259,328 against. No transaction, stake, price or advisor is involved; this is a routine meeting notice, not a special situation.
